svg.text: TV / MAKEUP CABINET v9 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Build the recessed base, then Sides, Bottom, Top and Back. Check square.
2. Fit the shelves at the modelled elevations. Keep the left-side finger setback.
3. Position 1300 mm from the hanging unit inner face; level and anchor both towers.
4. Select anchoring hardware for the actual wall before loading or fitting tall doors.
